quote: I cannot thank Frank de Planta enough for the support and guidance he has given me throughout the initial planning stages and then during the study itself. He is simply excellent at administrating and delivering a first class, gold plated package. My group of 30 individuals were totally captivated with his depth of knowledge, relentless enthusiasm and cracking sense of humour – although some of his jokes need more work to improve them. Simply the best tour I have ever attended and I would highly recommend it.
name: Capt Mark McMullan
